source.name: OpenStreetMap waterway ways (Tin Shui Wai Nullah)
source.method: waterway ways buffered to a ribbon and point-in-polygon rasterised onto the analysis grid

caveats: Channel width is a screening constant (half-width 15 m), not a survey of the nullah's true bank-to-bank width.
The mask covers the channel bed a basin must not sit on; the broader floodplain is deliberately left in the candidate pool.
